sources.revision: Mutable GitHub main README inspected 2026-10-20; no source commit, package, browser runtime, or DWG converter was pinned or executed.
sources.observed: The README says DXF loading uses the built-in MIT parser. Open-source DWG loading is opt-in through a GPL-3.0 LibreDWG converter rather than registered by default. The rendering roadmap calls its pipeline 2D-only and marks R12-to-latest version compatibility in progress. It mentions Three.js but provides no ACIS parsing or B-rep semantic route in the inspected README.
sources.limits: The current README does not establish exact implemented entity coverage, DXF output-writer behavior, 3D semantics, or whole-file/owner-graph preservation. With the optional LibreDWG converter, DWG observations share LibreDWG parser lineage. No code, package, test, or native viewer was executed.
